overall: The AG found the commission violated the Open Meeting Law when the chair's March 1 email, expressing an opinion on a pending matter to a quorum of members, constituted an improper email deliberation.

allegations.summary: A complaint alleged that the commission deliberated by email outside a posted meeting, through a chair's email sent to six members.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the March 1 email sent by Chair Noonan to the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law because it constituted a communication between a quorum of the public body.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
Caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the law's requirements, and we caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
